title: Date and time together
text: One field for a calendar date and a time of day, returned as an exact instant.

title: Time zone handling
text: Shows wall-clock time in a chosen time zone and resolves daylight saving gaps explicitly.

title: Business calendar
text: Weekends and holidays are marked and can be made unselectable.

title: Time steps
text: Suggested times in steps from one minute to twelve hours, on a 12 or 24 hour clock.

title: Form ready
text: Limits, validation, custom errors, and native form submission.
